description.sv: Kurerad inredningsmässa på Praterinsel mitt i München, kopplad till textilmässan Münchner Stoff Frühling. Tredje upplagan, plus visningsrum i innerstaden.
description.en: Curated interior design event on Prater Island in central Munich, linked to the Munich Fabric Spring textile fair. Third edition, plus showrooms across the city centre.

source.note: in-muenchen.de (Münchens stadsportal): tredje upplagan 11–14 mars 2027, Praterinsel. Öppettider ungefärliga (2026: 10–18, sön 10–17).
